notes: Psalm 151 — the supernumerary autobiographical psalm of David, treated as a separate USFM book (PS2) in our schema since the modern 150-Psalm numbering used by both translations doesn't accommodate it inline.

Both translations contain the same 7 narrative beats (David as shepherd, building the lyre, sending of the angel, anointing, his brothers, the foreigner / Philistine, the beheading), but ar splits the closing v7 ("drew sword + beheaded + removed disgrace") into ar v7 (drew sword) and ar v8 (removed disgrace, with closing Hallelujah). This 1→2 split gives ar 8 verses to en's 7.
Verses 1-6 align cleanly between translations. The split occurs only at the end.
